articles_hs_check.name: articles_hs_check
articles_hs_check.value: ("articles"."type" = 'product' and "articles"."hs_code_id" is not null) or ("articles"."type" = 'service' and "articles"."hs_code_id" is null)

company_settings_logo_check.name: company_settings_logo_check
company_settings_logo_check.value: ("company_settings"."logo_data" is null) = ("company_settings"."logo_mime" is null) and ("company_settings"."logo_mime" is null or "company_settings"."logo_mime" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'))

company_settings_bank_check.name: company_settings_bank_check
company_settings_bank_check.value: ("company_settings"."bank_name" is null and "company_settings"."bank_account_holder" is null and "company_settings"."bank_account_number" is null) or ("company_settings"."bank_name" is not null and "company_settings"."bank_account_holder" is not null and "company_settings"."bank_account_number" is not null)

company_settings_bank_length_check.name: company_settings_bank_length_check
company_settings_bank_length_check.value: ("company_settings"."bank_name" is null or char_length("company_settings"."bank_name") <= 80) and ("company_settings"."bank_account_holder" is null or char_length("company_settings"."bank_account_holder") <= 120) and ("company_settings"."bank_account_number" is null or char_length("company_settings"."bank_account_number") <= 34) and ("company_settings"."bank_swift" is null or char_length("company_settings"."bank_swift") <= 11)

discussion_messages_event_check.name: discussion_messages_event_check
discussion_messages_event_check.value: ("discussion_messages"."kind" = 'comment' and "discussion_messages"."event_type" is null and "discussion_messages"."event_key" is null) or ("discussion_messages"."kind" = 'event' and "discussion_messages"."event_type" is not null and "discussion_messages"."event_key" is not null)

exchange_messages_terminal_check.name: exchange_messages_terminal_check
exchange_messages_terminal_check.value: ("exchange_messages"."status" = 'sent' and "exchange_messages"."sent_at" is not null and "exchange_messages"."error_message" is null) or ("exchange_messages"."status" = 'failed' and "exchange_messages"."sent_at" is null and "exchange_messages"."error_message" is not null)

exchange_messages_reply_token_check.name: exchange_messages_reply_token_check
exchange_messages_reply_token_check.value: ("exchange_messages"."reply_token_hash" is null) = ("exchange_messages"."reply_token_expires_at" is null) and ("exchange_messages"."reply_token_hash" is null or "exchange_messages"."reply_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

supplier_replies_attachment_check.name: supplier_replies_attachment_check
supplier_replies_attachment_check.value: ("supplier_replies"."attachment_name" is null) = ("supplier_replies"."attachment_mime" is null) and ("supplier_replies"."attachment_name" is null) = ("supplier_replies"."attachment_size" is null) and ("supplier_replies"."attachment_name" is null) = ("supplier_replies"."attachment_data" is null) and ("supplier_replies"."attachment_name" is null or (char_length("supplier_replies"."attachment_name") between 1 and 200 and "supplier_replies"."attachment_name" !~ '[/\\]'))
